adjacent_probe_source.source:
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(sys.argv[1])
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'composite/MtoULiveLink/prototypes/scene-reference/maya/MtoUSceneRefPrototype/scripts'))
import MtoUSceneRefPrototype as ref
ref.ensure_maya()
mc = ref.commands()
stem = root.parent/'.tmp/issue53-fix-20261008/ue-automation/peer/MtoUSceneRef_Host'
name = ref.DEFAULT_CONTAINER
result = {}
def run(dry=True):
    report, code = ref.run(str(stem)+'.fbx',str(stem)+'.manifest.json',dry_run=dry)
    return {'code':code,'ok':report['ok'],'problems':report['problems'],'update':report['update']}
def baseline():
    mc.file(new=True,force=True)
    value=run(False)
    assert value['code']==0
    return mc.ls(name+':'+name,uuid=True)[0]
original = mc.namespace
try:
    old=baseline()
    retired=name+ref.RETIRING_SUFFIX
    mc.namespace(rename=(name,retired))
    def refuse_restore(*args,**kwargs):
        if kwargs.get('rename')==(retired,name):
            raise RuntimeError('review refused restore rename')
        return original(*args,**kwargs)
    mc.namespace=refuse_restore
    try:
        value=run()
    finally:
        mc.namespace=original
    value['old_paths']=mc.ls(old,long=True)
    assert value['code']==1 and value['old_paths'] and any('RECOVERY_REFUSED' in p for p in value['problems'])
    result['restore_refused']=value
    value=run()
    value['old_paths']=mc.ls(old,long=True)
    assert value['code']==0 and value['old_paths']==['|'+name+':'+name]
    result['restore_retry']=value

    old=baseline()
    mc.namespace(add=retired)
    group=mc.createNode('transform',name=retired+':'+name)
    mc.addAttr(group,longName=ref.OWNERSHIP_ATTRIBUTE,dataType='string')
    mc.setAttr(group+'.'+ref.OWNERSHIP_ATTRIBUTE,ref._ownership_mark(name),type='string')
    copy_uuid=mc.ls(group,uuid=True)[0]
    def refuse_retired(*args,**kwargs):
        if kwargs.get('removeNamespace')==retired:
            raise RuntimeError('review refused retired removal')
        return original(*args,**kwargs)
    mc.namespace=refuse_retired
    try:
        value=run()
    finally:
        mc.namespace=original
    value['current_paths']=mc.ls(old,long=True)
    value['retired_paths']=mc.ls(copy_uuid,long=True)
    assert value['code']==1 and value['current_paths'] and value['retired_paths'] and any('RECOVERY_REFUSED' in p for p in value['problems'])
    result['retired_removal_refused']=value
    value=run()
    value['current_paths']=mc.ls(old,long=True)
    value['retired_paths']=mc.ls(copy_uuid,long=True)
    assert value['code']==0 and value['current_paths'] and not value['retired_paths']
    result['retired_removal_retry']=value
    print('4 adjacent recovery checks passed')
finally:
    mc.namespace=original
    (out/'extra.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    import maya.standalone
    maya.standalone.uninitialize()
